rationale: The assistant correctly homed in on overheat protection from restricted ventilation after the new drawer, using exactly the evidence the customer gave (timing, roaring fan, recovery after cooling) and never inventing checks or facts. It respected the customer's refusal to do DIY, offered sensible no-tools workarounds, a practical tip for catching the fleeting code (film the display), and escalated appropriately to the fitter and Samsung support. The only weakness is slight overconfidence ('That pretty much nails it') given the hidden truth leaves a fan/board fault possible, though it did later acknowledge a hob fault as an alternative; no parts were recommended.
